const key = Symbol("key");
const other = Symbol("other");
interface A { [k: string]: number; [key]: string; }
interface B { [k: symbol]: number; [key]: number; [other]?: number; }
interface C { [k: symbol]: number; [other]?: number | undefined; }
class E { [k: symbol]: number; static [key] = "x"; [other] = 1; }
interface F extends B { [key]: number; }
interface G { [k: symbol]: number; }
interface H extends G { [other]: string; }
type T = { [k: symbol]: number; [key]: string };
class Dict { [k: symbol]: number; [key] = "x"; }
const o: { [k: symbol]: number } = { [key]: 1 };
console.log(o[key], new Dict()[key]);
